neighbours.label: the piece ' д' that starts the Russian word for 'door' (дверь, двери, дверью, дверца; tokenized ' д' + 'верь'), mid-sentence after an adjective, preposition or verb (входную дверь, постучал в дверь); quiet on other Russian д- words (двор, дача, дыня), on 'door' in English, French or German, and when the door word opens the sentence
neighbours.notes: Step-in reader of bonsai1/L32/N8965+ (non-English split word pieces), drop 0.04. Far narrower than its feeder: probes put door words at 0.17-0.58 and other д- words (дыни, детскую, даче, двор, дворник) at or below 0.1. Feeders-first arm: top feeders are ' Im' surname pieces (L25/N8666+) and 'при' cells, consistent with word-start pieces. Solver timed out; no leak report. Blind test written by a label-only author.
